lessons.title: 1. String Concatenation & Indexing
lessons.description: Strings can be joined with `+` and characters accessed by index `s[0]`. Negative index `s[-1]` gives the last character.
learning_objectives: Concatenate strings and index single characters

lessons.title: 2. String Slicing
lessons.description: Slice substrings using `s[start:end]`. Omitted start defaults to 0, omitted end defaults to length. `s[:-1]` drops the last character.

learning_objectives: Index and slice strings with positive and negative indices
